Definition
[Ideal-boundary angle] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0486 ↗ def:chow-iii-i1-rays-busemann 1. appi:eq-1.7\group Asymptotic cones

For rays $\gamma _1,\gamma _2\in \Ray _{\M }(p)$ define \[ \ddinf (\gamma _1,\gamma _2)=\lim _{s,t\to \infty } \zeta _{\gamma _1(s)p\gamma _2(t)}\in [0,\pi ], \] where $\zeta $ is the Euclidean comparison angle.
